headline: SG freebies: last day Sat 14 Nov for the free Jurong Lake Gardens magnetic pin; S.U.R.E. library bookmark ends Sun 15 Nov + 8 more
verdict: Go to Jurong Lake Gardens on Saturday 14 Nov, the last day, for a free magnetic pin from the stamp rally: it is guaranteed, free and only while stocks last.

plan.do: Jurong Lake Gardens: 3 counter stamps and a crossword get you a free magnetic pin. Last day, so go early.
Jurong West Library: solve S.U.R.E. Mission 1 for a free bookmark. Then go to Jurong Point L1: a Castlery charm keychain for a free sign-up.
Capitol Singapore outdoor plaza: Christmas Playland. Finish the quest card for a free present (12–8pm).
City Square Mall B1, Farrer Park: clear 7 Warrior 24/7 stations for a key charm and a Beutea voucher. Last day, closes 6pm.
